import os,subprocess,json,time,pathlib,hashlib
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();out=root/"scripts/edge_sem/artifacts/ep8_v1/cpu_tests_v1"
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False);results=[]
for name in ("edge_sem","node_sem","DFG/dfg_v2"):
 args=["/home/zhao/miniconda3/envs/mando/bin/python","-B","-m","pytest","-q","-p","no:cacheprovider","scripts/"+name+"/tests"]
 log=out/(name.replace("/","_")+".log");started=time.monotonic()
 with log.open("x",encoding="utf8") as f:done=subprocess.run(args,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 value=dict(suite=name,command=args,exit_code=done.returncode,seconds=time.monotonic()-started,log=dict(path=str(log),sha256=hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
 results.append(value)
 with (out/(name.replace("/","_")+".json")).open("x",encoding="utf8") as f:json.dump(value,f,indent=2)
 if done.returncode:break
with (out/"results.json").open("x",encoding="utf8") as f:json.dump(dict(passed=len(results)==3 and all(r["exit_code"]==0 for r in results),suites=results),f,indent=2)
